page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in single-threaded tasks, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2074.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 33.6 GB/sec. Image processing and text processing benchmarks also fall into the top 25% tier. Multi-core performance is characterized as average, with a Passmark CPU score of 48904.2 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 15951.0. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which assist in cryptographic operations and low-latency text generation for small language models, yielding 286.26 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model.

From a resource density perspective, the c7i-flex.8xlarge offers a balanced compute-to-memory ratio of 1:2, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that require dedicated compute power without the overhead of local storage. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible network-attached storage configurations. This server is optimized for workloads such as static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 51.12 GB/sec, as well as software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale machine learning inference.
